entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Did We not expand your chest for you (O Beloved)?
And (We) removed that burden from you (O Beloved).
Which had broken your back (i.e. an expression of extreme worry).
And We have elevated your remembrance for your sake.
So indeed, with hardship there is ease.
Indeed, with hardship there is ease.
So, when you complete Salah, strive in supplication.
And incline towards only your Lord.
